constraints.description: Representative integrated React surfaces and component stories must run fail-closed accessibility checks with no disabled Storybook a11y tests and no in-scope axe violations.

validation.validation_method: Dedicated Playwright axe suite plus full Vitest/Storybook suite

constraints.description: Desktop and compact interactions remain keyboard operable, modal focus returns to the trigger, one main landmark remains, status is textual, and focused actions expose a 3px ember indicator.

validation.validation_method: Playwright keyboard, computed-style, landmark, status, and target-size assertions

constraints.description: The runtime surface must pass at 320, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS pixels in light and dark themes without page overflow, shell overlap, inaccessible targets, or an incorrect navigation mode.

validation.validation_method: Eight-cell serial Chromium matrix plus a representative high-contrast pass

constraints.description: The complete frontend, browser, real-server, build, budget, coverage, OpenSpec, acceptance-classification, and protected-scope evidence must be reported without converting known or separately owned gaps into passes.

validation.validation_method: Verification report, KnowMe checklist, file inventory, strict OpenSpec, and protected digest

global_rules: Remediate only accessibility or responsive defects reproduced by C-15 probes.
Do not claim axe is a manual screen-reader usability study.
Keep real-backend, Flutter, and separately owned product assertions explicitly classified.
Do not modify .gitmodules, the Prometheus skill-system submodule, protected Rust API files, or operator-owned staged license deletions.
termination_conditions: All four blocking constraints have repeatable evidence.
Strict OpenSpec validation and protected-scope verification pass.
No critical finding remains after fresh artifact-only adversarial review.
